nodes.name: SKILL Runtime Refinement Design
nodes.summary: Architecture-spec for centralizing SKILL string-literal escaping, transport/non-nil result semantics, and JSON decoding into a new internal `client::skill_runtime` module sitting between domain commands and `VirtuosoClient::execute_skill()`. Defines four runtime capabilities (string literal, require_transport, require_non_nil, decode_json), a data-flow diagram, migration scope across `src/commands/sim.rs`, `process.rs`, `ocean/mod.rs`, `schematic.rs`, and `maestro.rs`, error-handling rules, TDD test strategy covering runtime unit tests and OCEAN builder regressions, explicit non-goals (no typed SKILL AST, no new CLI commands, no daemon wire changes), and completion criteria requiring a shared decoder/escape path, schematic noun parser removal, and strict Clippy + full test pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown spec primarily in Chinese with embedded pseudo-code, ASCII data-flow block, and bash validation commands; references Rust source paths and function names without including executable code.

nodes.name: Native Remote Transport Design
nodes.summary: Comprehensive design for a pure-Rust russh-based SSH transport running as a hidden local `vcli __transport-daemon` mode, layered atop the existing OpenSSH backend and selected explicitly via `VB_SSH_BACKEND=native`. Documents v1.2.0 delivered status with explicit deltas (SOCKS5/ProxyJump and RAMIC/X11 forwarding deferred), terminology distinguishing transport daemon from `virtuoso-daemon`, `RemoteTransport` trait, `Arc<dyn RemoteTransport>` handoff, connection identity/pooling, channel scheduler with capacity invariant, file transfer via streaming SFTP, reconnect/retry safety, host-key and SSH configuration policy, versioned local IPC protocol with state-file versioning, error model, health/observability, dependency boundary (no Python/Paramiko/libssh2/system SSH), testing topology with contract tests, and delivery sequence table. Calls out Linux/macOS/Windows integration matrices.
nodes.languageNotes: English-language architecture spec with extensive Markdown tables, code-fence references to Cargo features and CLI flags, and per-step delivery tracking; largest file in the batch at 617 lines / 41 sections.

nodes.name: Upstream Hardening Design
nodes.summary: Tight hardening spec covering three concerns after a Maestro upstream pull: (1) Maestro command safety via a local POSIX shell-word quoting procedure applied to `netPath` inside the generated SKILL program, preserving `dec=<N>` injection and forbidding `/tmp/vcli_dec_skill.txt` diagnostic writes; (2) Clippy gate restoration by replacing seven string parameters of `LayoutOps::xstream_out` with `XstreamOutRequest<'a>`, using `LibraryOps` unit struct directly, and collapsing two boolean equality / nested empty-window conditions; (3) a strict opt-in PSF access layer (`PsfDataset`, `read_psf_ascii_strict`, `find_exact_result_file`, `require_scalar/vector/frequency_hz`) with strict path-containment and explicit error mapping (`NotFound`, `Config`, `Execution`, `Io`). Validation enumerates test-first acceptance via `cargo test --lib client::maestro_ops`, `cargo test --lib spectre::parsers`, full `cargo test`, strict Clippy, and `cargo fmt --check`.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown design spec in English with embedded Rust API signatures inside a fenced code block; concise at 60 lines with 6 sections, references existing public function names and validation shell commands.

nodes.name: Virtuoso GUI Real Executor Design
nodes.summary: Design for wiring `.claude/skills/virtuoso-gui-debug/` to a live Virtuoso session through `vcli`, SSH, and X11 while enforcing a Rust-side safety boundary. Reports remote-probe findings (session `dean-user1-34929`, port `34929`, cached PID zero, X11 scratch permission failure on `/tmp`). Defines a Rust `vcli window` X11 boundary exposing fixed-semantic DSL operations, a Python `LiveExecutor` paired with the existing `FakeExecutor` (using an injected `CommandRunner`, never direct ssh/xdotool/xprop/shell), CLI flags `--executor live --vcli PATH --ssh-host HOST`, a `precheck` sequence validating session/PID/DISPLAY/unique window/exclusive DISPLAY lock, a `baseline/execute/verify/recover` flow with TYPE-log redaction, collaboration rules for the remote `virtuoso-skill-dev` skill, closed-fail failure strategy, and a phased smoke test starting from read-only checks before any keystroke/text/click/drag is permitted.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown design written primarily in Chinese with English CLI flags, function names, and host identifiers; references skills under `.claude/skills/virtuoso-gui-debug/` and a remote `virtuoso-skill-dev` that is not present in the local skill catalog.
